'''Korin Norrus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] cyber specialist who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Norrus was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where she was defeated by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] infiltrator around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
